room_geometry.observed_evidence: Visible chairs, floor, counter edge and walls are physically plausible.

circulation.observed_evidence: Medium framing does not expose a clear entry-to-counter or waiting-to-exit path.
circulation.recommended_repair_action: Move to a much wider public-side corner master that exposes the full floor path.

spatial_anchors.observed_evidence: The counter, entry, workstations and waiting zones cannot all be located in this framing.
spatial_anchors.recommended_repair_action: Include entry frame left, waiting rows centre-left and full counter/workstations frame right.

master_coverage.observed_evidence: This is a medium two-shot, not a geography-establishing wide master.
master_coverage.recommended_repair_action: Make both principals small full-body figures within a wide room composition.

character_count_identity.observed_evidence: Two clear foreground principals remain distinct.

background_population.observed_evidence: Only about two background adults are evident; the planned 8–12 and roughly 60% occupancy do not read.
background_population.recommended_repair_action: Show eight to twelve ordinary background adults distributed across chairs and safe walkways.

crowd_continuity.observed_evidence: Too few background adults and too little room coverage to assess crowd continuity.

blocking_and_framing.observed_evidence: The patient and nurse are staged beside each other in the waiting area rather than separated by the reception counter.
blocking_and_framing.recommended_repair_action: Keep patient on the public side screen left and nurse behind the counter screen right.

gaze_and_eyeline.observed_evidence: The opening poses are close to frontal/lens-axis attention before the pair turn toward each other.
gaze_and_eyeline.recommended_repair_action: Use distant three-quarter profiles and keep pupils on the interlocutor or work target.

anatomy_contact.observed_evidence: Visible limbs and floor contact are plausible.

wardrobe_construction.observed_evidence: The nurse lacks the planned open warm-grey cardigan construction.
wardrobe_construction.recommended_repair_action: Restore the plain grey open cardigan over slate-teal scrubs.

prop_identity_ownership.observed_evidence: No featured prop was planned in this shot.

privacy.observed_evidence: No patient identifier or readable monitor content is evident.

unwanted_text.observed_evidence: A small illuminated background fixture is present but too small to determine whether it violates the zero-icon policy.

lighting_continuity.observed_evidence: Warm interior light is coherent, though the background daylight is weak.

performance_action_match.observed_evidence: The patient approaches, but the intended natural elbow cough is not clearly readable in the contact sheet.

audio_sync.observed_evidence: No dialogue or source audio is required for this text-to-video draft.

continuity.observed_evidence: The depicted blocking cannot seed the planned counter-based coverage.
continuity.recommended_repair_action: Repair the wide geography before creating character references.

symbolic_environment.observed_evidence: Teal seating and warm wood communicate an ordinary clinic without overt exposition.

occupancy_target.observed_evidence: Visible occupancy is materially below the 50–70% profile target.

monitor_orientation.observed_evidence: The workstation is not established clearly enough to verify orientation.

counter_separation.observed_evidence: The principals appear on the same side of the counter.

profile_card_privacy.observed_evidence: No health card is shown in this shot.
